blurb: Hill Crest Farm offers private and semi-private dressage lessons tailored to individual goals for adults and young adults, using either the rider's own horse or lesson horses. The farm provides a full-service equestrian facility with well-maintained stables, paddocks, and an indoor arena. Lessons focus on building fundamentals, confidence, and horsemanship, with a recommendation for consistent monthly scheduling.
